# Octicons: GitHub's mark (MIT)

`mark-github-16.svg` is GitHub's mark from GitHub's icon set, Octicons, as published at
<https://github.com/primer/octicons> (`icons/mark-github-16.svg`), unchanged. Octicons is
licensed MIT; see `LICENSE`. GitHub's own guidelines for the mark are at
<https://github.com/logos>.

The editor shows it as the top bar's link to its source (`apps/web/src/ui/SourceLink.tsx`).
